Policy

Privacy.

How we handle the information you send through this website.

What we collect

What you enter in our forms: name, phone, email, vehicle details, a description of the damage, any photos you upload and, if you choose, your insurer’s name. We don’t ask for policy numbers, Social Security numbers or payment details here.

How we use it

Only to respond to your request, prepare your estimate and communicate about your repair. We don’t sell your information or share it with marketers.

Where it’s stored

Submissions are delivered to the shop’s email and stored with our website host’s form service. Inquiries that don’t become repairs are deleted after 12 months. Ask us to delete your information anytime at JCHAutoWorks@yahoo.com.

Analytics

If analytics are enabled, we ask for consent first and use them only to see which pages are useful.
